description: This file defines the 'PluginBridges' module for the Isomorphic SmartClient framework, including class definitions for various plugin components such as BrowserPlugin, Applet, Flashlet, SVG, and ActiveXControl, along with their methods and initialization routines.

classes.name: BrowserPlugin
classes.description: Base class for browser plugins, providing methods for drag handling, plugin management, and rendering.

classes.name: Applet
classes.description: Class representing Java applet plugins with methods for initialization, rendering, and interaction.

classes.name: Flashlet
classes.description: Class for Flash plugin components, including version detection and embedding logic.

classes.name: SVG
classes.description: Class for SVG plugins, handling SVG rendering, event handling, and native mask management.

classes.name: ActiveXControl
classes.description: Class for ActiveX controls, generating inner HTML for embedding ActiveX objects.

methods.name: handleDragMoveNotify
methods.description: Placeholder for drag move notification handling.

methods.name: initWidget
methods.description: Initializes a plugin widget, registers it, and sets up drag mask if needed.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes the plugin instance and performs cleanup.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Handles drawing the plugin, including back mask suppression.

methods.name: getPluginHandle
methods.description: Returns the DOM element handle for the plugin.

methods.name: getPluginID
methods.description: Returns the unique ID for the plugin element.

methods.name: createDragPlaceholder
methods.description: Creates a placeholder label for drag operations.
